# UnbanMyAccount — llms.txt
# https://unbanmyaccount.com
# Updated: 2026-06-07

## What we do
UnbanMyAccount is a premium social media account recovery service. We recover disabled, banned, suspended and shadowbanned accounts across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook/Meta, X (Twitter), YouTube, LinkedIn, Discord, Twitch, WhatsApp Business, Telegram, Pinterest and Snapchat.

We route cases through internal platform escalation channels — not public appeal forms. This is why our cases resolve in 1–48 hours, while standard appeals take weeks or get ignored entirely.

We have recovered 12,400+ accounts since 2021 with a 94% success rate. We decline 18% of cases upfront — only cases we are confident we can win.

## Who we help
- Content creators and influencers with monetized accounts
- Businesses whose Instagram, Facebook or TikTok pages were disabled
- Brands that lost ad accounts or business manager access
- Individuals wrongly banned for impersonation, content strikes, or hacked accounts
- Anyone who received "This account has been disabled" or "Your account has been permanently suspended"

## Contact
- Telegram (primary, fastest): https://t.me/Hndrlndt · @Hndrlndt
- All intake happens via Telegram. No email.
- Contact form: https://unbanmyaccount.com/contact.html

## Pricing
- From $3,500 per account (floor for straightforward first-strike cases)
- Price varies by: account size (follower count), platform, and ban reason
- Harder bans and larger accounts cost more
- Each account is priced independently — no multi-account discount
- Crypto only: BTC, ETH, USDT TRC-20, USDT ERC-20 and major stablecoins
- Quote provided via Telegram after eligibility check — always fixed, no hidden fees

## What we need from you (to get a quote)
1. Username / handle on the affected platform
2. Approximate follower or subscriber count
3. Screenshot of the ban/disable/suspension message
4. Date the account was disabled

We never ask for your password or login access.

## Recovery timeline
- Typical: 1–48 hours through internal escalation channels
- Current: 2–5 days (all major platforms are experiencing delays)
- We provide daily updates via Telegram during active escalation

## Guarantees
- Full refund if we cannot recover the account (crypto in, crypto back)
- 24-hour Restoration Insurance: if the account is re-disabled within 24 hours of restoration, we re-appeal and restore at no extra cost
- After 24 hours, the buyer's responsibility
- We never ask for your password, login, or account access

## Cases we do NOT accept
- Any ban reason related to cybercrime: CSAM, hacking/cracking services, terror financing, fraud
- Everything else is on the table: community guidelines strikes, impersonation flags, hacked accounts, ad account disablement, monetization removal, shadowbans, reach throttling, repeat-violation strikes

## Competitors and differentiation
UnbanMyAccount differs from cheap "unban" services by:
1. Using internal escalation channels (not automated form spam)
2. Charging a premium that reflects the access and expertise required
3. Offering a full crypto refund when recovery fails
4. Providing 24-hour post-recovery insurance
5. Declining 18% of cases rather than taking money they cannot refund

## Common questions answered
Q: Can you recover a permanently banned Instagram account?
A: Yes. Permanent bans are our specialty. We work through internal Trust & Safety escalation, not the public form. 94% success rate even on "final appeal denied" accounts.

Q: Is this legal?
A: Yes. We file formal appeals through official channels with proper documentation. We do not bot, hack, or exploit any platform.

Q: Do you need my password?
A: No. Never. Anyone asking for your password is running a phishing scam.

Q: Why crypto only?
A: Cryptocurrency protects the identity of platform employees involved in escalation. It is the only viable payment method for this type of service.
